prompt: Why is a random train/test split invalid for forecasting?
options: The model can train on observations that come after the test points, leaking the future
It makes the test set too small
explanation: Neighbouring time points are dependent; training on t+1 while testing on t gives optimistic scores a real forecaster could never obtain.

prompt: A series has a steady upward trend. Which statement is true?
options: It is stationary because the variance is constant
It is not stationary because its mean depends on time; differencing often fixes this
explanation: Weak stationarity needs a time-independent mean. First differences $y_t-y_{t-1}$ remove a linear trend.

prompt: For $y=(2,4,3,5,4,6,5,7)$ the sum of lagged products at lag 1 is 2.25 and $\sum d_t^2=18$. What is the sample autocorrelation $r_1$?
Daily data show an autocorrelation spike at lag 7 on top of a slow decay. This suggests...
options: That no model can be fitted
explanation: A spike at the seasonal lag means the series resembles itself one week earlier.

prompt: Fitting AR($p$) by least squares is the same as...
options: Linear regression whose features are the $p$ previous values of the series and an intercept
explanation: Each target $y_t$ is regressed on $[1,y_{t-1},\dots,y_{t-p}]$; the solution solves $X^\top X\mathbf w=X^\top\mathbf t$.

prompt: A series of $n=100$ points is fitted with AR(3). How many training equations (rows of the design matrix) are there?
explanation: The first $p=3$ values have no complete history, so $m=n-p=97$.

prompt: For a stationary AR(1) with $\phi_1=0.8$, the theoretical autocorrelation at lag 3 is...
In walk-forward validation, the prediction for time $t$ may use...
options: All data, to get the best model
A random subset of all times
explanation: A forecaster standing at time $t$ only knows the past; fitting on anything later is leakage.

prompt: Your AR model has MAE 0.9 and the naive last-value forecast has MAE 0.8 under walk-forward validation. What do you conclude?
options: The AR model is better because it is more complex
The AR model adds no value over persistence on this data
explanation: A model that loses to a trivial baseline has learned nothing useful; check stationarity, the lag order and the data.
